links.outcome: Critical safety errors in guideline-based psoriasis treatment recommendations, LLMs versus dermatologists
links.effect: Experts made 1 critical error; LLMs made 5-9 each (Q = 17.10, P = 0.004). Experts made no critical errors in high-risk scenarios; all LLMs made at least one.
links.quote: Experts made no critical errors in high-risk scenarios, whereas all LLMs made at least one.

screen.reason: The study evaluates multiple large language models against expert dermatologists on clinical scenarios derived from treatment guidelines, assessing completeness and critical safety errors without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
